title: Compute the agreement you would get for free
concept: Two raters who each say yes 90% of the time agree 82% of the time by chance alone. That 82% is p_e, and it is what kappa subtracts.
skill: You can compute chance agreement from two marginals in your head, which is what makes a raw agreement number readable.
deeper: docs/30-learning/interview-prep/01-mathematical-foundations/cohens-kappa.md -- the full derivation, and why kappa can go negative
